$comment: The single source of truth for every published name (`12` §3.1).
`pnpm names:check` fails on any disagreement between this file, the BRAND constant in
packages/shared/src/brand.ts, the workspace package names, and the references in deploy/** and
.github/**. `pnpm names:apply` rewrites those references from this file.
`@comvivo/*` package return 404 from the npm registry, and github.com/comvivo returns 404. The
blocking finding in `12` §3.1 — that the unscoped name was taken, so `npx <name> init` could
not ship — does not apply to Comvivo and is resolved by the rename (ADR-024).
`org` is the owner account until the `comvivo` GitHub organisation and npm organisation exist;
that is owner ask H-6 in STATUS.md. The mirror repositories below do not exist yet either —
they are the targets `12` §3.8 creates, named here so they are named once.

legacy.$comment: Distribution names this project has used before. `names:check` fails if any appears; `names:apply` rewrites them. This is what makes the weekly rename drill (13 §3.A.6, M0-T19) a one-command operation rather than a hunt.
